quantities.name: Selected DC Bus Voltage and Selection Criteria

details.autoSteppingReasonFa: توان بالای ۳ کیلووات؛ ارتقا خودکار به استاندارد ۴۸ ولت صنعتی جهت ممانعت از اتلاف حرارتی DC.
details.selectionCriteria: Inverter DC bus nominal = 80% of MPPT ceiling; or class-inferred: <=10kW: 400V, <=100kW: 800V, >100kW: 1100V; BESS stepping: >120A triggers 12V->24V->48V

quantities.formula: V_dcBus = V_mpptMax * 0.8; auto-stepped battery voltage by current > 120A threshold

quantities.name: Required Operating Current per MPPT and Inverter Rating Margin

quantities.formula: E_gross = E_usable / (DoD * eta_rt * f_temp); Coverage_pct = (E_usable / E_night) * 100

quantities.name: System Target Inverter Loading Ratio (ILR) vs Fleet ILR
quantities.formula: ILR_fleet = P_dc / (N_inv * P_ac_unit)

quantities.name: Initial Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) Breakdown for G-1 and G-2
quantities.formula: CAPEX = Modules + Inverters + Structures + Cabling + Substation + Interconnect + Labor
assumptions: Utility powerplant has MV substation; ongrid residential omits MV

quantities.name: Year 1 Operational Expenditure (OPEX) for G-1
quantities.formula: OPEX_annual = CAPEX * annualOpexPctOfCapex + LandLease + GridFee

quantities.name: Levelized Cost of Electricity (LCOE) for G-1 and G-2
quantities.formula: LCOE = sum((CAPEX_t + OPEX_t)/(1+r)^t) / sum(E_t/(1+r)^t)
assumptions: NREL SAM LCOE discounted energy formulation

quantities.name: Financial Indicators (NPV, IRR, Payback) for G-1 and G-2
quantities.formula: NPV = sum(NetCashFlow_t / (1+r)^t); IRR solves NPV(r)=0; Payback = cumulative cash flow break-even
assumptions: PPA tariff 2800 Toman/kWh (G-1); Retail tariff 3800 Toman/kWh (G-2); 15% escalation

quantities.name: Year-by-Year Cash Flow Table across 25 Years (G-1)
quantities.formula: NetCashFlow_t = Revenue_t - OPEX_t - FuelCost_t - Replacements_t
assumptions: 25-year full lifecycle projection with 0.5%/yr degradation and 15%/yr tariff escalation

quantities.name: Tariff Escalation Sensitivity Analysis for G-1 (15%, 5%, 0%)
quantities.formula: Parametric sweep of tariffEscalationPct in [15, 5, 0] yielding NPV/IRR/Payback matrix

quantities.name: POST /api/v1/solar/position seconds vs milliseconds timestamp divergence
quantities.formula: new Date(timestamp) in solar position handler

assumptions: server endpoint computes basic LCOE ignoring degradation, inflation, and tax schedules
